80/20 split by image ID; expected1200/300 only if1500pairs survive matching. Declared109patients/1500pairs are source metadata, not observed sample/patient counts. Original challenge test differs ReX held-out original training pairs.

No native pixel shape/spacing/orientation/correspondence recovered; grader converts PIL mode to grayscale L (OpenCV fallback), float32 display values, not acoustic speed/HU/calibrated signal. Enhanced output resized to high reference shape via INTER_LINEAR; geometry mismatch may be hidden.

LNCC independently min-max normalizes each image;11pixel square cv2 filter windows; only local variance>1e-10 in both contributes. Uniform images normalize to zeros, so allclose branch can report1 even if raw constant levels differ; a source rule, not measured result.
SSIM and PSNR use joint maximum-minus-minimum range, not a fixed255; exact identical arrays PSNR infinite. Score ranges cannot be presented as universally0–1.

Metric means are over merged image rows, not patients or organs. Inner merge row-count equality is the coverage check; no explicit unique-ID/set-equivalence assertion, so duplicated rows can offset missing ID count.

Pinned leaderboard present: append average metric row; higher-better method=min ranks per metric; overall mean position is lower-better, percentile uses competitor-row count. Fallback negative(LNCC+SSIM+PSNR/30) has no /3 or (PSNR-20)/30 and differs normalized description composite.
